supersession.reason: User withdrew the 50-question set before formal results and requested a redesigned 100-question set with distribution review before freezing.

scope.name: bounded Graph Retrieval experiment
scope.description: A manually curated, provenance-bound Property Graph is compared with Dense retrieval. It is an experiment, not a production GraphRAG system.

graph_contract.storage: versioned JSON loaded into in-memory adjacency indexes
graph_contract.document_scope_rule: Every returned edge and evidence chunk must be backed by an allowed document_id; a node alone never authorizes evidence from another document.

query_and_graph_ranking.entity_recognition: case-insensitive course-code regex plus aliases frozen from corpus metadata; no LLM
path_order: more exact query entity matches first
query_and_graph_ranking.evidence_order_within_path: path traversal order, then assertion_id ascending

retrieval_arms.description: Dense-only with the same bounded retry policy as the graph arm
Graph plus Dense fusion with the same bounded retry policy

same_for_all_arms: Embedding provider, model, dimensions, and score threshold
same_for_retry_arms: retry trigger based only on Dense results
fairness_controls.allowed_graph_difference: The graph arm may inspect up to five provenance-bound graph candidates per round before RRF, but only five fused candidates leave a round. The pre-fusion pool is reported so this cost is not hidden.
fairness_controls.answer_refusal_metric_scope: Deterministic evidence-gated behavior only; this experiment does not measure LLM prose quality.

fusion.dense_rank_input: score descending, chunk_id ascending for ties
fusion.score_formula: sum(1 / (60 + rank)) across available dense and graph rankings
fusion.round_merge: Keep fused first-round order, then append unseen second-round chunk_ids in fused second-round order.
fusion.duplicate_budget_rule: Duplicates still consume their source retriever rank and do not trigger a third retrieval.

retry_policy.decision_input: Dense results only, before graph fusion, for both retry-enabled arms
selection_rule: retain at least one gold-evidence chunk for every answerable development question
among eligible thresholds, maximize unsupported development questions with fewer than two retained results
then maximize mean reciprocal rank on answerable development questions
break remaining ties by choosing the lowest threshold
retry_policy.graph_code_gate: Do not implement graph retrieval until the formal semantic threshold is recorded in a new preregistration-only commit after explicit Provider budget approval.

evidence_scoring.match_rule: filename and page_number must match, and normalized chunk text must contain the exact frozen snippet
evidence_scoring.evidence_recall_at_5: unique gold evidence matched by the five final candidates divided by total gold evidence
evidence_scoring.reciprocal_rank: 1 divided by the first rank that matches any gold evidence; zero when none matches
evidence_scoring.evidence_ndcg_at_5: Each rank gains one only when it first covers a previously unmatched gold evidence item; divide DCG by the ideal placement of min(5, gold count) unit gains.
evidence_scoring.multi_hop_required_evidence_coverage: matched required evidence across multi_hop questions divided by all required multi_hop evidence
evidence_scoring.citation_identity: returned document_id and chunk_id must identify the retrieved chunk
evidence_scoring.citation_source_page: returned filename and page_number must equal the source chunk metadata
evidence_scoring.citation_semantic_support: the cited chunk must contain at least one frozen gold snippet supporting the expected answer
evidence_scoring.graph_path_correctness: For each graph-scored question, report the fraction of frozen gold paths whose full assertion_id sequence is returned with connected nodes and complete edge provenance.

auxiliary_metrics: R6 routing accuracy on its separate fixture
dense, graph, pre-fusion, and final candidate counts
embedding request, token, and cost estimates

paired_analysis.unit: same frozen question across all three arms
paired_analysis.win_tie_loss_rule: Report wins, ties, and losses separately for per-question Evidence Recall@5 and Evidence nDCG@5 using exact numeric deltas.

promotion_thresholds.failure_decision: Record a negative or inconclusive experiment and keep Dense as the production path.

git_sequence: real-provider development calibration and threshold freeze after approval
